# VFX Reference Dossier — ground_targeted_circle (non-PoE supplement)

## Candidate 1: Meteor rune variants (Diablo 3)
- source_game: Diablo 3
- skill_or_mtx_name: Meteor — base, Comet, Meteor Shower, Star Pact, Molten Impact
- primary_url: https://www.purediablo.com/meteor-runestoned-videos
- secondary_urls: https://eu.diablo3.blizzard.com/en-us/class/wizard/active/meteor
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: Dedicated rune clips show the complete remote placement sequence: casting delay, descending projectile, circular impact, and persistent molten or frozen ground. The variants are especially useful for comparing how color, scale, and projectile count can change while preserving the same ground-targeted-circle grammar.
- readability_notes: The impact center and lingering circular footprint remain clear at the standard isometric camera. Molten Impact is the cleanest large-circle reference; Meteor Shower is busier and communicates a distributed zone instead.

## Candidate 2: Devastation (Grim Dawn)
- source_game: Grim Dawn
- skill_or_mtx_name: Devastation
- primary_url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DnjciTIoa2Y
- secondary_urls: https://grimdawn.fandom.com/wiki/Devastation_%28Skill%29
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: This dedicated skill overview demonstrates a remotely placed zone followed by repeated arcane projectiles falling into the selected area. The sustained bombardment clearly separates invocation, active duration, and individual impacts; the effect is demonstrated throughout the skill-specific video.
- readability_notes: Repeated impacts establish the circular footprint temporally rather than through a hard perimeter. The luminous violet projectiles read well against Grim Dawn’s muted terrain, although overlapping explosions can soften the exact edge.

## Candidate 3: Doomsday (Lost Ark)
- source_game: Lost Ark
- skill_or_mtx_name: Doomsday
- primary_url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iQdfbZvrwNo&t=33s
- secondary_urls: https://lostark.fandom.com/wiki/Doomsday
- media_type: video
- temporal_coverage: windup=Y; active=Y; impact=Y
- why_it_fits: At timestamp 00:33, the showcase isolates Doomsday’s long casting windup, targeted meteor descent, and large circular ground impact. It is a particularly strong reference for communicating anticipation and payoff at a quarter-view gameplay camera.
- readability_notes: The descending meteor creates a strong focal axis into the target center, while the circular explosion clearly communicates damage scale. The bright impact bloom briefly obscures the boundary, making it better for impact hierarchy than persistent edge definition.

- Searched Diablo 3 Meteor, Blizzard, Firebats, official game-guide pages, dedicated skill clips, and rune-effect showcases; verified the Meteor rune showcase and official skill page.

- Searched Last Epoch Meteor, Grim Dawn Trozan’s Sky Shard/Devastation, and Lost Ark Sorceress/Doomsday showcases. Last Epoch results were primarily proc-heavy build footage that obscured the manually placed circle, so they were not promoted.
